data.name: Photo_ToneAutomaticDescription
data.value: Follows the HDR10+ curve a video carries, and otherwise uses the PQ spline.

data.name: Photo_ToneSplineDescription
data.value: Balances midtone contrast and highlight detail, and adapts to scene brightness when a video provides it.

data.name: Photo_ToneBt2390Description
data.value: Broadcast standard curve. Keeps shadows and midtones unchanged and smoothly compresses highlights.

data.name: Photo_ToneBt2446ADescription
data.value: Broadcast standard conversion for well-mastered content, aimed at a target peak brightness.

data.name: Photo_ToneClipDescription
data.value: Shows everything within the display's range exactly and cuts off brighter highlights. Best when accuracy matters more than highlight detail.

data.name: Photo_ToneMobiusDescription
data.value: Keeps brightness and colour exact below the knee point and gently rolls off highlights above it. Favours accuracy over highlight detail.

data.name: Photo_ToneReinhardDescription
data.value: Smoothly compresses the whole range. Keeps overall brightness, but flattens fine detail and contrast.

data.name: Photo_ToneHableDescription
data.value: Film-like curve that keeps detail in both shadows and highlights, at the cost of a slightly darker, softer picture.

data.name: Photo_ToneGammaDescription
data.value: Keeps brightness below the knee point exact and compresses every step of brightness above it evenly, preserving texture in bright areas.

data.name: Photo_ToneLinearDescription
data.value: Compresses all brightness evenly, keeping every highlight at the cost of overall brightness. Raise exposure to brighten the picture; highlights that no longer fit are clipped.
